positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Architecture of internal C++ Electronic Control Unit (ECU) Simulator
•	Architecture of Pytest-based testing framework for simulator external control to enable controls firmware integration testing
•	Provisioning, management, and abstraction of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing assets
•	Development of infrastructure including on-demand and regression testing Jenkins pipelines using Groovy, Python, and Bash
•	Creation of tools and utilities in Python, including custom integrations with Jama, Jira, Slack, Bitbucket, and Gitlab
•	Design of configuration (YAML, JSON, TOML) and serialization (Protobuf) schemas
•	Development of applications, models, and views for a web dashboard in Django, Python, JavaScript, Jinja2, CSS, and HTML.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Test Management and +9 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Initiated and led conversion of System Integration Testing (SIT) efforts from Word documents to MKS Integrity test suite management software. Architected testing strategy, training materials, automated conversion mechanisms, reporting tools, and test development, execution, and debugging workflows. Organized a team of 10 developers in coordinated testing efforts, defect triage, and generation of artifacts for customer sign-off.
•	Worked on Multi-Spectral Targeting System (MTS) simulation including sensor modeling, power, and MIL-STD-1553 communications interface implementation. Re-architected and modularized existing simulation code by leveraging Interface Control Document (ICD) commonalities across various customer targeting systems.
•	Provided primary air vehicle simulation support for Block 50 Ground Control Station (GCS) technical development, which included rapid response feature parity, System Integration Lab (SIL) debugging, and live demonstrations to customers and VPs.
•	Architected and implemented modular simulation design for Universal Armaments Interface (UAI) including extensible abstractions for platforms, carriages, launchers, and stores, as well as several concretized implementations for the Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC) MQ-9B operational requirements.
•	Revitalized automated regression testing efforts using Jenkins and an internal Python-based automated testing framework. Fixed framework issues, test scripts, and wrote utilities to aid in automated reporting and triage of defects.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), C (Programming Language) and +7 skills

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed and optimized automation scripts using VBScript and AutoIt to test software virtualization layer visibility on my own initiative, resulting in a 40% increase in suite size with a marginal increase in suite execution time.
•	Modified and executed manual test suites using TestLink and VMware Workstation for the entire suite of Application Jukebox cloud products, including extensive compatibility and interoperability testing across all Windows and some Linux platforms.
•	Monitored and debugged automation regression tests and updated test suites for Windows 10 compatibility. 
•	Participated in daily scrum meetings as part of an Agile process, and created and verified JIRA issues during sprints.
